resources.title: Fractions

Ordering of fractions. v. Conversion of fractions to decimals and vice versa. vi Conversion of fractions to percentages and vice versa
resources.objectives: Students should be able to: 1. identify equivalent fractions of any given fraction; 2. resources.activities:
Teacher: 1. Leads students to recognize that ½ , 2/4, 4/8, are equivalent fractions i.e. ½ = 2/4 = 4/8 2. Guides students to apply the equivalent fractions in sharing of commodities e.g. food, money etc. 3. Leads students to solve problems in quantitative aptitude involving equivalent fractions. 4. Leads students to arrange given fractions in ascending or descending order of magnitude. 7. Leads students to convert:  fractions to decimals;  decimals to fractions. 8. Guides students to convert:  fractions to percentages;  percentage to fraction.
